_about: Manual PF-1 classification of every candidate file in the approved source folder (post-freeze knowledge expansion). Keys are file names; values are the audit judgements that cannot be measured by the scanner: canonical title, issuing unit, system, topics, audience, language, date evidence, officiality, relevance, extraction class, screenshot dependence, duplicate or version status, specialist mapping, handbook overlap, status, priority and notes. Measured facts (size, hash, pages, text volume, images, Arabic share) come from inventory_scan.py; build_inventory.py merges both.
